**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All parse clean with `node --check`.

Left alone: `[vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9)` and `:13`. Its header says do not edit, since upgrades overwrite it. So `db.query` must stay in `lib/db.js` until that vendor drop ships a fix. Also left `cache.query` calls alone. Different object.

Next: ask the vendor for an `execute` build, or wrap the adapter.
